★Request
Display Buena Vista (Jersey, Summer)

(The eyes looking straight at me are as kind as they were back then...
—Yet stronger now than they were back then.)

Because, because...! 
It's just so breathtakingly beautiful...!
...! No, I just got here myself.

(I haven't seen them since back then. Does Trainer's eyes
still sparkle like that even as an adult? Hehe.)

Big Bro, which fireworks do you like best?
Bu-chan loves the golden ones!
(As she murmurs that, her expression turns bitter.)

Heheh, hehehe...!
Oh, honestly...!

...You've really learned how to pull off unexpected surprises
so casually, haven't you?

Big Sis, which fireworks do you like best?
Bu-chan loves the golden ones!
Huh? ...Are you sure?

(The final run of the summer training camp...!
I'll show what Trainer and I achieved... together!)

That's not fair.
No matter how much I chase after you... it's never enough.

Getting to know you,
and wanting to know more... makes me so happy.

Really?
Hehe, I'm looking forward to it.

Yeah, yeah... *sniff*.
Huh? Why am I... *sob*...!

(Still... you remembered that we watched fireworks together back then.
...Hehehe.)
Yaaaahhhhhh!!
...For me...?
Saying you 'just couldn't help it' is...!

Right! ...And that's a wrap.
Summer camp really flew by in the blink of an eye, didn't it?

Can I stay right beside you... in the closest spot?
And keep watching you?
Because you just keep showing new sides of yourself.

...Yeah, absolutely...!
Let's do it. Wait here, I'll go look for an event!

...We went to watch them together back then too, didn't we?
Mom dressed me up in a yukata, and we went up a tall building...

Hehe, we really ran non-stop.
Nothing but running. I guess that counts as youth too, right?

W-What do you mean, 'what's wrong'...! 
I mean, this is... a ship, or rather, we're out on the ocean!?

You said we'd go see fireworks...
...Did you book a cruise ship...?

...You've really changed.
So much since we were kids.

I'd love to see them even closer...!
If we did, it'd look like they're gently raining down from above, wouldn't it?

...Well then, shall we go?
Around where will it be?
(Side by side with you, I burn this dreamlike spectacle into my memory.)

...I could never have imagined...
A cruise ship, of all things.
Because I want to know everything about you, from now on too...!

Grown-ups really are amazing, after all...
You just keep getting cooler and cooler.

I wonder why?
They feel even more............ than when we watched them before.
So... beautiful.

(...I was only looking at the fireworks.
I never realized where that golden light was shining.)

No, not at all.
Right now... I'm just so happy, I can't help it.
Then, the meeting time will be—

"For Buena's sake, I can give it my all no matter what.
I can keep growing to no end—that's all there is to it."
Huh?
Whaaat...!?
...Huh?
...Big Bro.
...Big Sis.

Trainer, apparently there's a fireworks festival.
Doesn't that sound so summery?
...Did I arrive too early?

Wow...! It's so pretty!
Ehehe, Tamayaaa!

Big Bro, which fireworks do you like best?
Bu-chan loves the golden ones!
Trainer, thank you so much!
—Ah, I see.

Big Sis, which fireworks do you like best?
Bu-chan loves the golden ones!

...How nostalgic.
I wonder if we can see them closer than back then?

(Said so casually, in a totally nonchalant tone.
Acting as if pulling off something incredible was the most natural thing in the world.)

(The fireworks shot up.
Giant blossoms bloomed in the sky, far larger and more grand than what I saw that day.)

Ah, it's the golden fireworks...!
...Amazing. They're showering down, sparkling all over...
Big Sis.

Hey, the parts of you that stay the same, Big Sis,
as well as the parts that change...

Hey, the parts of you that stay the same, Big Bro,
as well as the parts that change...
Big Bro.
